comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body:
No, the Narrow-sleeved Beizi doesn't have any attack power aside from some defense, it's just one of the very few equipments for female characters that gives +2 rowing. Theres two versions of that clothing though. The one that also gives +1 to swordplay and steering is obtained as a nanban reward in Chongqing if you trade there and have your nanban points in China maxed out. The other that just has +2 rowing is a rare drop from these level 59 NPCs in Loess Plateau, and can also be plundered from the Merchant raider fleet hanging around China.

If on the other hand your looking for 60 disguise equipment for females, theres Odalisque Dress which comes from the same book.
